title: Fever State Simulation to Study the Behavior of Novel Ti-Mn Alloys for Medical Devices
content: The development of new biocompatible materials is necessary to improve the durability and effectiveness of medical implants. Titanium alloys have received much attention due to their corrosion resistance [1], proven biocompatibility [2], and ideal strength-to-weight ratio. Consequently, Ti alloys are used in the chemical, aerospace, automotive, and even biomedical industries [3].
